title: Lovers by the Lily Pond
description: A romantic couple stands intimately in a lily pond, the man in a ornate blue and green historical jacket with tattoos visible on his leg, the woman in a flowing green and white clover-patterned dress whispering in his ear. The scene is framed within an old television screen, surrounded by transparent bubbles containing small images, with a classical portrait of a woman floating in the background.
prompt: A romantic couple standing in a lily pond, the man wearing an ornate blue historical jacket with green shirt and black pants with visible tattoos on his leg, the woman in a delicate green and white dress with clover patterns and flower crown whispering into his ear, soft sunset lighting over a serene lake with weeping willow trees, surrounded by floating transparent bubbles containing tiny images, a classical female portrait floating in the background, the entire scene displayed inside an old wooden television set frame, surreal and painterly style.
